content: विश्रम्भः .²1 Trust, confidence, familiar confidence, perfect intimacy or familiarity; विश्रम्भादुरसि निपत्य लब्धनिद्राम् <ls>U. 1. 49</ls>; <ls>Māl. 3. 1</ls>. .²2 A confidential matter, secret; विश्रम्भेष्वभ्यन्तरीकरणीया <ls>K.</ls> .²3 Rest, relaxation. .²4 An affectionate inquiry. .²5 A love-quarrel, an amorous dispute. .²6 Killing.
